name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, Household Profiles, Guest Passes & Seerr Requests for Jellyfin
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with flexible Google/OIDC/Jellyfin sign-in, dedicated Kids profiles, real-time synced Watch Together, toggleable QR Guest Passes, optional Seerr/Jellyseerr search requests, and 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users.
